title: Watching hockey nearly doubles your heart rate 🏒
description:
Watching hockey can nearly double your heart rate. Scientists strapped heart monitors on fans, and overtime was the peak, like a full workout from your seat. Leafs fans, we don't even wanna know.

Sources (PubMed):
Khairy et al., Can J Cardiol 2017 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28987521/
Wilbert-Lampen et al., N Engl J Med 2008 — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18234752/

Background photos: Nathan Baessi and Rishabh Malhotra on Unsplash.
Not medical advice.
